name: Beriah
overview: The name Beriah appears in Scripture referring to multiple individuals connected to different tribes of Israel, highlighting the diverse family lines within God's covenant people. Notably, Beriah is a son of Asher, whose descendants form distinct families such as the Beriites, emphasizing God's orderly establishment of tribal lineages (Genesis 46:17; Numbers 26:44-45). Additionally, Beriah is mentioned in the genealogy of Ephraim, reflecting the continuation of God's promises through the patriarchs (1 Chronicles 7:20-22). These references demonstrate God's faithfulness in preserving His people through successive generations across various tribes.
